prompt: 我有智谱 GLM Coding Plan 套餐，想用套餐额度做一个本地代码库的 RAG 问答：先用 embedding-3 把代码切片向量化，再用 glm-5.3 回答。用 Python 写，直接 requests 调 HTTP。
assertions: The response states that embeddings (embedding-3) are NOT covered by the Coding Plan and must be called with a standard platform API key at https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4/embeddings

The chat/answer step uses the Coding Plan endpoint https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/coding/paas/v4/chat/completions with model glm-5.3 (or glm-5.3-flash) when using the plan key — or clearly explains the user may instead use the standard key for everything
The script reads two separate keys from two environment variables (one for the plan, one for the standard API) rather than assuming a single key works on both endpoints
The embeddings request uses the documented shape: POST /paas/v4/embeddings with JSON body {model: 'embedding-3', input: <string or list>} and reads vectors from response['data'][i]['embedding']
Script is valid Python with a working retrieval loop (cosine similarity or equivalent) and a chat call that injects the retrieved chunks into the prompt
